svg.title: Maknae action vocabulary: the 61-term map, what is built, and what blocks what
svg.desc: Left-to-right dependency map of the action vocabulary: 61 terms, 59 client actions and 2 kernel action strings. Twenty-one terms are built, shown at the top grouped by the issue that built them: liveness.ping; admin.whoami; fs.read, moved to the client by issue 365; issue 158 fs.write, fs.delete and fs.mkdir; issue 161 fs.list and fs.stat, decided as fs.read; issue 162 admin.status, admin.config.show and admin.subject.list; issue 490 admin.baseline.show and admin.baseline.accept; issue 165 admin.contain, admin.release and kernel.contain; issue 170 session.new, session.close, session.list and session.delete; and issue 172 session.prompt. Below, 18 issues hold the 40 unbuilt terms by dependency depth; issue 610 builds session.task, which issue 609 already decides and which answers Unauthorized until it lands. Column 1, drawn across two columns, has no open blocker in this map; issue 175 waits on issue 477, the execution-isolation ADR, outside it. Column 2 waits on column 1, and column 3 on column 2. A fifth column, drawn neutral because its terms are outside the vocabulary, holds planned, proposed or superseded terms: fs.search (issue 373), fs.append (issue 405), ssh.exec, ssh.copy_to and ssh.copy_from (issue 458), agent.task (issue 475, superseded by session.task), issue 482 console verbs not yet named, and issue 168, which has no verb.
svg.text: The action vocabulary — 61 terms, what is built, and what blocks what
21 built, 40 enumerated-but-unbuilt across 18 issues. Tracked in epic #182; enumerated by #67. Columns run left to right by dependency depth. State as of #624.
kernel action string — no Verb variant, not client-reachable
blocks (previous column only; other blockers are named in each box)
BUILT — decided, dispatched and serving today
21 terms. Grants: code arms for ping and whoami; authz.yaml permissions: for fs.*; authz.yaml roles: for the rest. Every unbuilt term of the 61 is enumerated and decided, and answers Unauthorized.
